# MiniPlayer

The running timer as a slim bar, so a focus session or Pomodoro is visible from every screen.

`CLR.MiniPlayer` · Focus and timer

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.MiniPlayer phase={…} remainingSeconds={0} totalSeconds={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.MiniPlayer" phase="{{…}}" remaining-seconds="{{0}}" total-seconds="{{0}}"></x-import>
```

| prop | type | note |

| `phase` * | `'idle' \| 'work' \| 'short_break' \| 'long_break' \| 'focus_mode'` |  |
| `remainingSeconds` * | `number` |  |
| `totalSeconds` * | `number` |  |
